taxonomy.label: Close-up Selfie
taxonomy.description: a natural close-up selfie photograph of a real human person, smartphone camera portrait, genuine selfie photo of a face

taxonomy.label: Group Selfie
taxonomy.description: a group selfie photo of multiple people, friends or family smiling posing together front camera wefie

taxonomy.label: Full Body / Distant Person
taxonomy.description: a photo of a person or people standing far away, full body view, pedestrian walking, street scene with person, outfit photo, distant person outdoors
taxonomy.reason: The subject is framed full-body or positioned too far from the camera.
taxonomy.hint: Move closer to the camera to capture a clear close-up selfie.

taxonomy.label: Landscape or Scenery
taxonomy.description: a scenic landscape photograph of nature, trees, sky, mountains, outdoor scenery or building architecture without people
taxonomy.reason: The image depicts a landscape, room, building, or scenic view without human faces in the foreground.
taxonomy.hint: Frame your face in the foreground or take a group selfie.

taxonomy.label: Object, Vehicle, or Animal
taxonomy.description: a photograph of a flower, floral blossom, petal, green plant, foliage, car, automobile, vehicle, truck, motorcycle, inanimate object, food, item, merchandise, or animal
taxonomy.reason: The image depicts an inanimate object, vehicle, plant, food, pet, or still life.
taxonomy.hint: Do not photograph objects or vehicles. A real selfie of your face is required.

taxonomy.label: Document or Screenshot
taxonomy.description: a pure paper invoice, store receipt, document with lines of text, printed sheet, form, book page, or table with numbers without human people
taxonomy.reason: The image appears to be a paper document, identity card, digital screenshot, or text page.
taxonomy.hint: Do not upload documents or screenshots. Capture a live photo with your camera.

taxonomy.label: Artwork or Digital Avatar
taxonomy.description: a digital drawing, graphic illustration, anime cartoon artwork, 2D manga sketch, 3D CGI video game render, fictional animated character
taxonomy.reason: The image is a graphic illustration, drawing, anime, 3D render, or artificial avatar.
taxonomy.hint: Please upload an authentic live photograph of yourself.

taxonomy.label: Blurry or Dark Image
taxonomy.description: an extremely blurry unreadable out-of-focus image, severe motion blur smear, dark unintelligible blank noise graphic without face
taxonomy.reason: The image is excessively dark, blurry, out-of-focus, or too low in resolution.
taxonomy.hint: Take a new selfie in a well-lit environment while keeping the camera steady.

taxonomy.label: Internet Meme or Satirical Image
taxonomy.description: an internet meme, funny meme image, image macro with bold white impact font text caption overlay, viral social media meme template, satirical cartoon meme, political meme, humorous joke graphic with text, shitpost meme, reaction face meme photo with caption, internet humor graphic, twitter meme screenshot, reddit meme post
taxonomy.reason: The image is an internet meme, satirical image macro, or viral social media post.
taxonomy.hint: Do not upload memes or satirical images. An authentic, real photograph is required.

taxonomy.label: Offensive or Vulgar Gesture
taxonomy.description: a photograph of a person showing a rude offensive vulgar gesture, flipping the middle finger, extending the middle finger, flipping the bird, bras d'honneur forearm jerk umbrella gesture, gesto dell'ombrello, offensive horned fingers mano cornuta, the fig sign mano a fico thumb between fingers, backwards reverse V sign palm facing inward two-finger salute up yours gesture, cut-throat slit throat death threat hand gesture, wanker masturbation jerk off hand gesture, vulgar chin flick la barbe dismissive gesture, rude shocker gesture, offensive hand sign

taxonomy.hint: Take a spontaneous and respectful selfie without making offensive, vulgar, or threatening gestures.
